note: Paths (relative to the game folder, forward slashes, as named in the Runtime zip) that every Runtime build declares as no longer shipped: the service deletes them at its next start (packaging/runtime/apply-removals.mjs). A Runtime update zip adds what it finds by comparing the two Runtimes (packaging/build-runtime-update.mjs). Keep a path here for as long as an installation that still has the file may update to a Runtime that is built from this list.
